lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, extending across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity values on the dorsal side and casting a shadow on the ventral side.
